reviews.x: The clips are fine but just super tiny. My fault for not seeing the measurements and taking the time to find out what that size looked like but they are small. Maybe adding a pic of what they actually look like in someone’s hair would help. Nice quality and pretty though.

reviews.t: Looks just like pics, feels sturdy
reviews.x: Bought this for someone with thin hair - this size ought to hold all her hair since anything larger, the hair just falls right out, and the tiny less-than-one-inch clips can't grab all her hair. We were delighted to find that it has little spikes on the inside of the clip to assist with gripping the hair. Her only concern is that the first time she put it in, her hair STILL slid out! Although to be honest, I think she was not clipping it correctly.  They felt very sturdy; the spring felt strong.

These hold my hair. I put my long hair up in a bun a lot. These hold my hair in place. The only issue is they don’t open that wide, so it can be an issue trying to get your hair in the clip. Like how they have a tight clamp.  ****UPDATE**** if you drop them on anything they break. If you purchase be careful not to drop. I’m on my last one now. Will not repurchase!!
Love the colors and firm of the product. I will definitely buy it again.

They broke after being in my hair for a day my hair isn’t thick or to thin. I put a bun in the morning and by the end of the day one broke a tooth of the claw and the other one came apart. I managed to save it but the next time I used it it broke again. I was sad because I needed some clips for my hair and the size was perfect. Unfortunately they didn’t last long.

reviews.t: All of them broke in less than 1 week
reviews.x: The clips are very cute but when you squeeze them open the cute print or solid piece pops off and you are left with the gold clip portion. Unfortunately, with out the larger pieces remaining on the clip, they are very hard to open. Threw all of them away. Will not be ordering them again. Save your money.
My hair is very thick. This is the first clip I’ve ever seen that would hold it up.

reviews.t: Looks like a great clip, but for hair much thicker longer than ine
reviews.x: Unable to really rate clip since really too large for my just below shoulder hair (and longer than I anticipated, but didn't measure clips I usually use to compare when buying so that's my fault). If i had fabulous really thick or curly hair, I think would work great for those luckier people. But, being a buyer of many clips, it appears to be of good quality & will give to friend with thicker/curly hair. I'll have to stick to buying clips for this reason to store shopping (uugh).

reviews.t: Great for my thin fine hair.
reviews.x: These clips came so nicely packaged and delivered timely to my mailbox. They are perfect for my fine thin hair which is hard to keep clipped with anything but this type of clip. 8 of them for the cost is a great value when they are delivered right to you so quickly and easily. I need two of them for my top knot.

Wife was looking for this type of hair claw for a while...as it had to have the same number of claws as the one she had from awhile ago....i was able to find it pretty quickly after i knew some info...she loves it....keeps her longer hair nice and comfortable.....thanks Amazon....

Took a while to get these, it’s a hard size to find- but worth the wait. These are bigger than the tiny tiny clips but just a step up.  Great to get my bangs out of my face. They look sturdy and come nicely boxed, do not look cheap. Glad I found them!

reviews.t: Finally!  A sturdy clip that can corral long, thick hair.
reviews.x: Specifically purchased this product to gather and hold in place my long, thick hair.  Other clips don't do the job, but this one does.  The search and price were worth it.  The clip not only works well, but it is also very attractive.

Within 2 months all 8 of these clips are broken. One hinge of the clip broke on every single one I got. They even gave complimentary hair ties that broke the first time I tried to put it in my hair. Poor quality.

These looked beautiful.  However they were very stiff and tight. They broke almost immediately when trying to put in my daughter's hair. I have one left that didn't break but I have not tried to use it.
Have used these clips for years. I always got them at Walmart and they have been out for a long time. I found these on Amazon and they are just as good as the ones I have always used.

reviews.t: Have already ordered 3 sets! Love them.
reviews.x: Love these! Nice and sturdy, I use them every day and have already ordered three sets so I have them in every bag and drawer (y’all know these little clips all seem to wander off).
Upon the first use of these clips, the additional colored plastic glued to them would pop off, rendering the clip unusable because the spring is so tough. Money wasted :(
My hair is past my shoulders probably to my bra line these are perfect if you wanna put your hair half up and not have the tightness of a scrunchie
My hair has been thinning so was looking for something that would hold my pony nicely. This is perfect because it doesn’t loose the pony tail.
Came as advertised and in a nice cardboard storage box . . . Caring packaging and a note with an email address if customer had Qs. Very nice.

reviews.t: Great (and sturdy) way to keep that long hair out of your face!
reviews.x: Very study hair clip to keep your hair out  of your face.  Face it...your hair has not been cut for months.  Put it up with this great clip!
I have fine thin hair.  Trying to keep what I have left at 63yrs ....using clips like these is not as hard on my hair as rubber bands  etc.
Looks great, broke within seconds of using. Color portion broke off hind inner clip. Appeared to just be superglued together.

reviews.t: Does the job and great value!
reviews.x: Great value! My two year old hasn’t been able to break them, so they are toddler resistant (unlike the other ones)!
These clips are smaller and work great with finer hair. I like how well it keeps my hair pulled back and in place.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the clips sturdy, attractive, and good quality, and they hold hair well.
A common complaint is that the clips break easily, often within days or weeks of use.
Several reviewers note the clips are very small or tiny, and some suggest clearer size photos or measurements.
Some reviewers find the clasp stiff and tight, making it hard to open or get hair into the clip.
Reviewers with thin or fine hair report the clips work well for them.
